<function name="SetDepressImage" parent="DImageButton" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Controls whether <page>DImageButton:DepressImage</page> is functional or not.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="enable" type="boolean">`true` to enable image depressing when clicked.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
